purpose: Test whether true complete B01 PROSE parents preserve occurrence and affirmative role direction after a subsequent EXPLICIT conversion.
selection: All 24 B01 PROSE parents, 8 materials x 3 fixed models. No error-based selection, no first-stage rerun.
assistant_prediction: 自然复述保留的方向有可能降低LLM-jp/Apertus后续角色转换错误，但再次转换也可能重现或新增错误；Qwen全正确旧基线用于保护检查。
sample_unit: 16 source sentence positions per model: 10 affirmative +6 negative; 8 reused context pairs, 2 domains, not independent n
primary_endpoint: Complete event correctness on each source position: occurrence C and affirmative-role C gives joint C; negative source requires unique NO without self-contradiction, role names alone do not assert occurrence. Unique opposite occurrence or unique opposite affirmative roles gives W. Omission, contradiction, indeterminacy gives U with reason. Conflicting claims stay U, not W.
scoring: Coordinator full-response AI annotation; no regex semantic gold, no B01 frozen score overwrite; new joint endpoint separately annotated on direct and chain outputs.
feasibility_gate: All24 children trace to true full parents; LLM-jp and Apertus each rescue >=1 direct affirmative-role W with zero joint C->W/U harms; Qwen zero joint new harms; occurrence states preserved across every model.
failure_action: If role errors persist or new harms appear, retain failures and stop at conversion diagnosis. No corrective round, additional QA call, new model or sample expansion.
stops: more than24 new calls or completed-call repeat risk
limits: Post-result continuation of exposed B01 parents, not independent end-to-end confirmation
Author supplied correct source range to first stage
Language, wording and stage count differ from direct EXPLICIT; no pure format or internal mechanism claim
Qwen Japanese parents remain Chinese-language failures, later conversion cannot repair that requirement
Quantity fidelity remains secondary unresolved; no blanket claim of fully correct translation
projection: Optional mechanical occurrence-fact projection only: NO yields no fact, UNKNOWN or unparsable remains unresolved; derived artifact not a model answer or broad QA repair test.
